# WizEdu

> > WizEdu is an educational question-and-answer platform providing detailed solutions across STEM disciplines including biochemistry, physics, chemistry, biology, calculus, and computer science.

The site features step-by-step problem solutions covering topics from cellular respiration and amino acid chemistry to circuit analysis, kinematics, and programming. Content spans undergraduate-level coursework across natural sciences, mathematics, and engineering with particular emphasis on biochemical pathways like the citric acid cycle and fundamental physics problems.

## Key Topics

- Citric acid cycle
- Cellular respiration
- ATP, NADH, FADH2
- Acetyl CoA and metabolic intermediates
- Circuit analysis and Ohm's law
- Kinematics and projectile motion
- Amino acids and protein chemistry
- Lewis structures and chemical bonding
- Calculus derivatives
- Mitosis and cell biology
- Population genetics
- Chemical equilibrium
- Monetary policy
- Orbital mechanics
- Hemodynamics

## Biochemistry & Cellular Metabolism

- [Which of these is NOT a product of the citric acid cycle?](https://wizedu.com/questions/377/which-of-these-is-not-a-product-of-the-citric): Biochemistry: citric acid cycle products including NADH, FADH2, CO2
- [Which of these enters the citric acid cycle?](https://wizedu.com/questions/376/which-of-these-enters-the-citric-acid-cycle): Cellular respiration: acetyl CoA entry into citric acid cycle
- [Indicate the name and one letter code for the (proteinogenic) amino acid best fitting the given description](https://wizedu.com/questions/257/indicate-the-name-and-one-letter-code-for-the): Amino acid identification: Asparagine, Glutamine, Lysine, Proline, Tyrosine

## Physics Problems

- [Speed of a Softball Solution (Mastering Physics Chapter 03: Motion in Two Dimensions)](https://wizedu.com/questions/47/speed-of-a-softball-solutionmastering-physics): Mastering Physics solution: projectile motion and kinematics problem
- [The mass of a high speed train is 4.5×10⁵kg, and it is traveling forward at a velocity of 8.3×10¹m/s](https://wizedu.com/questions/249/the-mass-of-a-high-speed-train-is-45105kg-and-it): Momentum calculation for high-speed train using scientific notation
- [Rank each satellite based on the net force acting on it](https://wizedu.com/questions/473/rank-each-satellite-based-on-the-net-force-acting): Satellite orbital mechanics: centripetal force ranking problem
- [The figure shows a combination of two identical lenses](https://wizedu.com/questions/104/the-figure-shows-a-combination-of-two-identical): Optics problem: lens combination, image formation, and magnification
- [Compared to normal blood flow velocity, v0, what is the velocity of blood as it passes through this blockage?](https://wizedu.com/questions/396/compared-to-normal-blood-flow-velocity-v0-what-is): Hemodynamics: blood flow velocity through arterial blockage

## Chemistry Solutions

- [Physical Chemistry chemical equilibrium question](https://wizedu.com/questions/493/physical-chemistry-chemical-equilibrium-question): PCl5 dissociation equilibrium with temperature and pressure effects
- [The formate ion, HCO2-, is formed when formic acid dissolves in water](https://wizedu.com/questions/274/the-formate-ion-hco2-is-formed-when-formic-acid): Formic acid dissociation: HCO2- resonance structures and Lewis diagrams
- [CH3NO2 Lewis structure](https://wizedu.com/questions/155/ch3no2-lewis-structure): Nitromethane (CH3NO2) Lewis structure with resonance forms

## Circuit Analysis & Electrical Engineering

- [What is the current through the battery in the circuit shown below?](https://wizedu.com/questions/146/what-is-the-current-through-the-battery-in-the): Circuit analysis using Ohm's law and Kirchhoff's junction rule
- [What are the magnitude and direction of the current in the 20 Ω resistor in (Figure 1)?](https://wizedu.com/questions/23/what-are-the-magnitude-and-direction-of-the): Circuit problem: current magnitude and direction through 20Ω resistor
